description: This file defines the CompositeCachingHealthCheckingActor class, an Akka actor responsible for aggregating health status information from multiple child actors representing different subsystems. It manages scheduling of health checks, caching of the latest statuses, and provides aggregated health data.

classes.name: CompositeCachingHealthCheckingActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that manages health checks of multiple subsystems by aggregating their status information, scheduling periodic health retrieval, and caching results.

classes.name: CheckHealth
classes.description: An internal immutable command class used to trigger health checks.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory method to create Props for the actor, given child actor properties, update interval, and feature toggle.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method; initializes scheduled health checks if enabled.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Lifecycle method; cancels scheduled health checks.

methods.name: matchCustomMessages
methods.description: Defines message handling behavior for relevant message types.

methods.name: triggerHealthRetrieval
methods.description: Uses cached health status to update external systems or UI components.

methods.name: inverseMap
methods.description: Utility method to invert a map's key-value pairs.

methods.name: getAggregatedStatus
methods.description: Compiles individual child statuses into an aggregated composite status.

methods.name: applyChildStatus
methods.description: Updates the cached status of a child actor upon receiving its status message.

methods.name: pollHealth
methods.description: Sends health retrieval requests to all child actors.
